title: Did you know? #2
topic: How many times your heart beats in a day
mainFact: An adult heart beats about 100,000 times a day.
supportingDetails: It pumps about 2,000 gallons (about 7,500 liters) of blood a day.
That adds up to about 35 million beats a year and more than 2.5 billion in an average lifetime.
Your heart is a muscle about the size of your fist, with four chambers.
source: American Heart Association: How the Healthy Heart Works / 'Your heart beats about 100,000 times a day'
caption: Your heart never takes a day off. Guess how many beats it does in 24 hours? 💓

scenes.narration: Your heart is doing something insane right now.
scenes.headline: Your heart is insane

scenes.narration: Every single day, an adult heart beats about one hundred thousand times. Without a break!
scenes.headline: Beats in one day

scenes.narration: And it is not huge at all. Your heart is a muscle about the size of your fist.
scenes.headline: As big as your fist

visual.caption: Your heart is about the size of your fist

scenes.narration: With every beat, it squeezes blood out to your whole body. Then the blood comes back to be pumped again.
scenes.headline: One loop of blood

scenes.narration: In just one day, it pumps about seven thousand five hundred liters of blood. That is a lot of blood!
scenes.headline: Liters pumped per day

scenes.narration: Inside, your heart has four rooms called chambers. Two on top, and two on the bottom, working as a team.
scenes.headline: Four rooms inside

scenes.narration: Now zoom out. In one single year, your heart beats about thirty-five million times. Wow.
scenes.headline: Beats in one year

scenes.narration: And over an average lifetime, it beats more than two and a half billion times. Billion!
scenes.headline: Over a whole life

scenes.narration: Quick recap. Your fist-sized heart beats about one hundred thousand times a day, without ever stopping.
scenes.headline: Quick recap

scenes.narration: Follow Pip for a new mind-blowing fact every day!
scenes.headline: A new fact every day!
